definitionZh: 边距内置的 CSS 短手属性既定义了元素的逻辑内置起始和结尾边距,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,文本方向,将元素映射到物理边距.
sourceDefinition: The margin-inline CSS shorthand property defines both the logical inline start and end margins of an element, which maps to physical margins depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
